caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary source supports S. pyogenes M1 strain 5448 with MIC 8 mg/L; DBAASP adds the M1T1 qualifier not found in local primary material.
Local database snapshot has no linked sequence row. Etamycin identity is source-reviewed from chemical structure/NMR/stereochemistry evidence rather than a linear peptide sequence.

The ten landed supplementary .bin files are HTML landing pages. The recoverable OA supplement DOC was opened with antiword and contains chemical/stereochemical support, not additional MIC/toxicity tables.
Protein-synthesis inhibition is discussed as presumed streptogramin-class context; direct molecular mechanism assays are absent in local material.
